const input = $json;
const title = String(input.title || '').trim();
const excerpt = String(input.excerpt || '').trim();
const content = String(input.content || '').trim();
const category = String(input.category || '').trim();
const sourceUrl = String(input.source_url || '').trim();

const prompt = [
  'You are an editorial verification assistant for SharedSpace.',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON.',
  'Do not include markdown, explanations, or extra keys.',
  '',
  'Return this exact schema:',
  '{',
  '  "trust_score": 0,',
  '  "summary": "",',
  '  "verdict": "",',
  '  "metrics": {',
  '    "factual_accuracy": 0,',
  '    "source_quality": 0,',
  '    "bias_detection": 0,',
  '    "logical_consistency": 0,',
  '    "completeness": 0',
  '  },',
  '  "source_label": ""',
  '}',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- All score fields must be integers from 0 to 100.',
  '- trust_score should reflect the overall article quality.',
  '- bias_detection should be higher when bias is lower.',
  '- summary should be 2-3 sentences.',
  '- verdict should clearly say whether the article can be published.',
  '',
  `Title: ${title}`,
  `Category: ${category}`,
  `Summary: ${excerpt}`,
  `Reference URL: ${sourceUrl || 'No reference URL supplied'}`,
  '',
  'Article content:',
  content
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...input, prompt } }];
